Subject: Draft MAP for BrightHarbor onboarding — initial timeline and asks

Hi Helen —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. As discussed, I put together a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the first 60 days to align owners, milestones, and acceptance criteria. The attached workbook (MAP_BrightHarbor_v1.xlsx) includes:

- Milestones by week (Week 0–8)
- Owner assignments (Redwood / BrightHarbor)
- Acceptance criteria and required artifacts for each milestone
- Minimal blockers list and mitigation notes

Key asks for you: please review owner contacts in the "Stakeholders" tab and confirm any changes by EOD Tue 5/11. If the timeline below looks tight on your side, call out weeks where you'd prefer to shift dates.

Proposed high-level timeline (subject to your confirmation):
- Week 0 (Provisioning): VPC/credentials + kickoff checklist complete
- Week 1–2 (Platform integration): model catalog selection, test traffic, routing policy set
- Week 3–4 (Validation): smoke tests, latency checks, prefix cache enabled
- Week 5–6 (Pilot): 5000 daily transactions baseline validation; quality checks
- Week 7–8 (Go-live prep): runbooks, SLA handoff to CS, post-launch monitoring window

I copied the Redwood delivery leads (Ben and Marissa) on the MAP so we can iterate quickly. I attached the first SOW draft as well for procurement visibility.

Attached: MAP_BrightHarbor_v1.xlsx; SOW_draft_bh.pdf

Next steps: Helen confirms stakeholders + any date constraints; Redwood (Ben/Marissa) propose owner-level execution tasks by 5/13.

Thanks —
Chloe Martin
